title: Regulatory Compliance & Basis Documentation
metaDescription: Licensing-basis documentation and regulatory support that demonstrates the protective strategy to regulators, in the form they require.
heroDek: A protective strategy that isn't documented to the regulator's standard isn't finished. GSS translates the underlying technical analysis into a basis a regulator can actually review.
contextHeading: A protective strategy that isn't documented to the regulator's standard isn't finished
contextParagraphs: Regulators require the protective strategy to be demonstrated in a specific documented form — physical security plans, safeguards contingency plans, licensing basis submittals — not simply implemented in practice. A site can be genuinely well protected and still fail review because the documentation doesn't demonstrate it in the required structure.

GSS translates the underlying technical work — vital area and target set analysis, timeline analysis, response strategy — into documentation built to satisfy that review, and supports the site directly through the regulator's inspection and question-and-response process rather than handing over a document and stepping back.
The same capability applies at both ends of a facility's life: operating sites managing and revising an existing basis, and new-build or SMR programs establishing one from a green field.

methodology.label: Basis Document Review
methodology.body: Existing licensing-basis and security-plan documentation reviewed against current analysis and regulation.

methodology.label: Gap Identification
methodology.body: Discrepancies between documented basis and demonstrated protective strategy identified.

methodology.label: Documentation Development
methodology.body: Basis documents, plans, and supporting analysis drafted or revised to close identified gaps.

methodology.label: Regulatory Engagement Support
methodology.body: Direct support through regulator review, inspection, and question-and-response cycles.

methodology.label: Change Control Integration
methodology.body: Documentation update process integrated into the site's configuration and change-control program.

faq.q: Does GSS interact directly with regulators?
faq.a: Yes — support extends through direct engagement and inspection response, not just document preparation.

faq.q: Is this only for operating facilities?
faq.a: No — new-build and SMR programs establishing a licensing basis from scratch are a significant part of this work.

faq.q: How often does basis documentation need updating?
faq.a: Whenever the underlying analysis or applicable regulation changes; it's integrated into change control rather than treated as a one-time deliverable.
